title: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce - Business Studies - Ethics in Sourcing Chemical
exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A distinct compound or substance, especially one which has been artificially prepared or purified for industrial or domestic purposes, is called
options: an occupation
a chemical
an industry
a machine
questions.explain: A **chemical** is broadly defined as any basic substance that is used in or produced by a reaction involving changes to atoms or molecules, commonly utilized in manufacturing, agriculture, and homes.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following is considered a chemical that is highly hazardous and strictly NOT suitable for general use?
options: Baking powder used in bakeries
Chlorine used for water purification
Banned toxic agricultural pesticides
Table salt used in food processing
questions.explain: **Banned toxic agricultural pesticides** are harmful to human health and the environment, making them strictly not suitable for use or circulation.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: What is the primary reason government agencies monitor and control the production and distribution of food, drugs, and chemicals?
options: To increase the prices of goods beyond what people can afford
To protect public health and the environment from harm
To create artificial scarcity in the open market
To discourage entrepreneurs from engaging in foreign trade
questions.explain: The monitoring of food, drugs, and chemicals is crucial **to protect public health and the environment** from the dangers of fake, expired, or hazardous products.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: The set of moral principles and rules that guide human behaviour and dictate what is right or wrong in business transactions is known as
options: distribution
fair play
ethics
aptitude
questions.explain: **Ethics** refers to the moral code or rules of conduct that govern an individual's or an organization's behaviour, distinguishing between right and wrong practices.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: According to the ethics of sourcing chemicals, manufacturing businesses must ensure they purchase their chemical supplies strictly from
options: roadside hawkers
unregistered smugglers
licensed chemical vendors
foreign retail tourists
questions.explain: Ethical sourcing requires that chemicals are obtained only from **licensed chemical vendors** who are legally recognized and regulated by the authorities.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Why is it ethically and legally necessary to source industrial chemicals from licensed vendors rather than unknown sources?
options: It ensures that the chemicals are genuine, safe, and easily traceable.
It ensures the chemicals are completely free of charge.
It guarantees that the chemicals can be used to harm competitors.
It allows the buyer to avoid paying any form of government tax.
questions.explain: Purchasing from licensed vendors **ensures authenticity, safety, and traceability**. If a chemical defect occurs, the regulatory authorities can easily trace it back to the authorized seller.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following practices represents a good and ethical technique for handling chemicals in a business environment?
options: Storing toxic liquids in empty beverage and water bottles
Tasting unknown chemicals to verify their concentration levels
Using appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) like gloves and masks
Mixing unidentified chemicals randomly to observe their reaction
questions.explain: A fundamental rule in the good technique of handling chemicals is to always **use appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE)** such as gloves, goggles, and masks to prevent physical injury.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Proper disposal of industrial chemicals is highly emphasized in business ethics primarily in order to
options: maximize the company's daily sales volume
prevent severe soil and water pollution
reduce the wages paid to factory cleaners
encourage the rapid spread of airborne diseases
questions.explain: Chemicals can be highly toxic. The ethical disposal of chemicals is critical to **prevent severe soil and water pollution**, thereby protecting the ecosystem and nearby communities.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: A manufacturing company that discreetly dumps untreated chemical waste into a nearby community river at night is severely violating the ethics of
options: licensed sourcing
advertising and marketing
proper disposal of chemicals
communication agencies
questions.explain: Dumping untreated waste into rivers is a direct violation of the rules guiding the **proper disposal of chemicals**, leading to environmental degradation.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of the following best describes 'good distribution' practices when transporting hazardous chemicals?
options: Transporting consumable food items and toxic chemicals in the same open truck
Using specialized, securely sealed, and appropriately labeled vehicles
Distributing the chemicals without any warning labels to avoid alarming people
Allowing untrained pedestrians to carry the chemicals across state borders
questions.explain: Good distribution entails safely transporting chemicals using **specialized, securely sealed, and labeled vehicles** to prevent spills, explosions, or cross-contamination with food items.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: All of the following are ethical guidelines for sourcing and managing chemicals EXCEPT
options: employing good handling techniques
patronizing licensed vendors
maintaining a safe distribution network
improper disposal in residential drainage systems
questions.explain: Handling, licensed sourcing, and safe distribution are all ethical guidelines. **Improper disposal in residential drainage systems** is highly unethical and illegal.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Continuous monitoring and control of food and drugs helps society by ensuring that
options: genuine doctors are completely banned from operating
expired, fake, and adulterated products are removed from circulation
waterborne diseases spread faster in rural communities
all forms of home trade are forcefully stopped
questions.explain: Monitoring bodies act as gatekeepers to ensure public safety by intercepting and destroying **expired, fake, and adulterated products** before they reach consumers.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Chemicals that have been strictly banned by regulatory agencies because they contain carcinogenic (cancer-causing) substances are classified under the syllabus as
options: chemicals suitable for use
essential commercial goods
chemicals not suitable for use
domestic aids to trade
questions.explain: Any chemical that poses severe health risks and is banned by authorities directly falls under the category of **chemicals not suitable for use**.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: What is the most appropriate and ethical method for a worker to learn the potential hazards and correct handling techniques of a newly purchased chemical?
options: Smelling the chemical deeply to determine its composition
Mixing a small portion of it with boiling water
Reading the manufacturer's instruction and safety data label
Leaving the container open under direct sunlight
questions.explain: Ethical and safe handling requires workers to always **read the manufacturer's instruction and safety data label (MSDS)** before opening or using any chemical to understand its hazards.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies

questions.q: Which of these is a likely direct consequence for a business organization that continuously fails to follow chemical safety and ethical sourcing rules?
options: Immediate expansion of its international trade network
Revocation of its operating license and closure of the premises
An automatic award of government manufacturing grants
A massive reduction in the cost of transportation
questions.explain: Regulatory agencies have the power to penalize unethical businesses. A major consequence of violating chemical safety laws is the **revocation of the operating license and closure of the business**.
questions.exam: BECE Business Studies: Commerce & Activities That Aid Commerce
questions.subject: Business Studies
